source: FIGURES.md pass, 2026-09-24. Source 1 (search): Keyword Planner ideas carried frankie knuckles (10K-100K), farley jackmaster funk, dj louie vega, godfathers deep house (1K-10K). Source 3 (asked): live PAA and PASF on 'house music' and 'what is house music'. Source 4 (consensus): DJ Mag, '40 essential tracks from 40 years of house music' (2024, read in full); Splice, Armada and LANDR structure. Source 5 (originators): Wikipedia House music, Chicago house, Frankie Knuckles, Move Your Body, Jack Your Body, Paradise Garage. Source 6 (catalogue): 9,073 house and 2,156 deep house sets of 62,824; most-watched house sets Solomun, Black Coffee, Fred again... Ahrefs sources were not run (Keyword Planner method, KEYWORD-METHOD.md 2026-09-22). Every embed checked by YouTube oEmbed on 2026-09-24; records from Topic, label or artist channels.
